title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. A single trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Live starts and first signals

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The ATOM path is a concrete instance of that expectation: entry at 2.066, exit at 1.703, and a measured result of -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit followed the 10-day low rule, and the measurement attached to that rule is -17.9% after costs. NEAR remains open from 5.896 on 12 October 2026, so it has no closed result yet in this record.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 is separately shown as open. With 0 positions open on paper across the three engines, the record currently carries no open paper positions except that NEAR entry. The distinction matters: the engines report 0 positions open on paper, while the signal log still shows the NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 as open. Both statements come from the same running record.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average of null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.34% net per trade. ATOM is one of those closed trades, with a result of -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. These are early counts: 4, 6, and 7 closed trades so far. The averages are therefore early measurements, not settled estimates. htf-rsi-v007's average is null, so no net average is reported for that engine. trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 both show negative average net per trade, at -13.22% and -13.34% respectively. The early losing start is consistent with the testing expectation that losses were common.

## Market filter and nearest breakouts

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With the filter off, both trend-daily engines show 0 positions open on paper. The filter state and the open position count are both read from the running record. For trend-daily-v005, the closest names to the 20-day breakout are ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high, BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high, and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, the same three distances are recorded: ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high, BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high, and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high. These percentages describe distance to the 20-day high, not a forecast. ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high is the nearest of the three in both engines. BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high are farther from their highs.

## Record status and where to check

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-07T20:43:25.187Z. The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Because the record updates continuously, the open positions, closed trade counts, averages, filter state, and breakout distances can change after this snapshot. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status carry the same numbers as this record. This article reports the live record as it stands, in plain language, with no projection.
